pages.quiz:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the Arabic word تُفَّاحٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. samak
   B. tuffaah
   C. jazar
   D. shaay

2. How is the Arabic word تَحْتَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿinda
   B. taHta
   C. amaama
   D. fii

3. Which sound does the Arabic letter ل make? (1 mark)
   A. l as in lamp
   B. m as in mat
   C. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   D. b as in bag

4. What does the ending -aani show in yadaani? (1 mark)
   A. many
   B. exactly two
   C. the
   D. my

5. What does the Arabic word مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) mean? (1 mark)
   A. and upon you peace (the reply)
   B. good evening
   C. hello
   D. What is your name? (to a boy)

6. Which of these is a characteristic of good handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Large gaps inside a word
   B. Even spacing between words
   C. Different sizes of letters
   D. Smudges

7. How do you read the syllable بِي? (1 mark)
   A. bii
   B. bi
   C. laa
   D. qaa

8. How is the Arabic word مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. as-salaamu ʿalaykum
   B. masaa'u l-khayr
   C. sabaahu l-khayr
   D. marhaban

9. What does the shadda over the last letter of umm tell the reader? (1 mark)
   A. The vowel is long
   B. The letter is silent
   C. The word is finished
   D. Say the letter twice

10. What does nahnu narqusu mean? (1 mark)
   A. We dance.
   B. I have a gift.
   C. I like the party.
   D. My mother cooks.

11. What does fii l-matbakhi taawila mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen there is a table.
   B. I like the kitchen.
   C. The book is on the table.
   D. The table is small.

12. How is the Arabic word افْتَحِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ukhruj
   B. ilmis anfaka
   C. ismaʿ
   D. iftahi l-baab

13. How is the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. fam
   B. mushmis
   C. qalam
   D. jadiid

14. What is the name of the Arabic letter د? (1 mark)
   A. Haa
   B. Saad
   C. daal
   D. khaa

15. Which Arabic word means "flower"? (1 mark)
   A. سَحَابٌ
   B. زَهْرَةٌ
   C. مَطَرٌ
   D. غَائِمٌ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write three classroom instructions in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Say why food is important for human life and name two foods grown in Kenya. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Name two common foods in your area and write one Arabic sentence about one of them, with its meaning. (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Name three rooms of the house in Arabic (English letters) with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Give the steps for reading a new Arabic word. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — tuffaah
   تُفَّاحٌ is read tuffaah and means apples.

2. B — taHta
   تَحْتَ is read taHta and means under.

3. A — l as in lamp
   The letter ل makes the sound l as in lamp.

4. B — exactly two
   The dual ending -aani means two, so yadaani is two hands.

5. D — What is your name? (to a boy)
   مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) means What is your name? (to a boy).

6. B — Even spacing between words
   Good handwriting has even spacing, correct shapes and neat presentation.

7. A — bii
   بِي is read bii.

8. B — masaa'u l-khayr
   مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ is read masaa'u l-khayr and means good evening.

9. D — Say the letter twice
   A shadda doubles the sound.

10. A — We dance.
   nahnu means we and narqusu means we dance.

11. A — In the kitchen there is a table.
   fii l-matbakhi means in the kitchen and taawila means a table.

12. D — iftahi l-baab
   افْتَحِ الْبَابَ is read iftahi l-baab and means open the door.

13. D — jadiid
   جَدِيدٌ is read jadiid and means new.

14. C — daal
   The letter د is called daal.

15. B — زَهْرَةٌ
   زَهْرَةٌ (zahra) means flower.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example qif (stand up), ijlis (sit down), iftahi l-baab (open the door).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Food gives energy to grow, learn and stay healthy. Examples are maize and bananas.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the importance and 1 mark each for two foods.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example maize and bananas. al-mawzu ladhiidh. The banana is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two foods, 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for its meaning.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 3.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at each letter and its mark; read each syllable; blend the syllables and check that the word makes sense.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.
